notes.title: Rat Trap: Fuse 'em Demo Update v1.093
notes.notes:
G'day! The "Rat Trap: Fuse 'em Demo" has been updated to v1.093.

This update includes a few small fixes and additions to the demo.

Added: Extra options in the pause menu to [b]improve performance[/b] (detailed lighting toggle, resolution options). 
Tweaked: Some fonts in-game for readability
Fixed: A pesky bug where the game could be softlocked if you die + retry. Now you can die all you want! :)

Steam has recently rolled out the ability to leave reviews on demos now. [b]If you've played the demo and can spare a moment to leave a review, that would be greatly appreciated![/b]

Lots of things are happening behind the scenes with the game, and you can hopefully expect to see a bit more later this year so please stay tuned. 

ALSO! If you live in Australia, please keep an eye out on the [url=https://discord.gg/w4AhYj5g6n]discord[/url] or [url=https://x.com/RasterRouser]twitter[/url] as the game will be making it's first public appearances soon!

---

Please consider joining the [url=https://discord.gg/w4AhYj5g6n]Rat Trap discord[/url] to provide feedback there, or use the steam community discussions.

notes.title: "Rat Trap: Fuse 'em Demo" v1.09 Update
notes.notes:
Hello! [b]The "Rat Trap: Fuse 'em Demo" has been updated to v1.09.[/b]

This update includes a few fixes to bugs/errors found in the previous version.

[list]
[*] Fixed: Saving and loading your game could sometimes spawn your character 'buried' in the ground
[*] Fixed: Music playing at incorrect volume (or not at all) for some players. Music volume slider in settings menu should be more consistent now.
[*] Fixed: Motion blur issue when swapping characters in certain rooms
[*] Tweaks to hopefully improve performance
[*] Tweaks to reduce/eliminate issues on character unlock
[/list]
[i]I still intend to improve a few more things for the demo; such as graphical/tutorial improvements and perhaps more.[/i]

A huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who played the demo and graciously provided feedback. Feedback of any kind allows the game to improve so please keep it coming! 

---

Please consider joining the Rat Trap discord to provide feedback there, or use the steam community discussions.
